text:
QUOTE: `batchRecords`, `processRecords`, `prepareRecords` and `handleRecords` all live on `BaseDataOperator`, so every server handler uses them.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says every server handler uses `BaseDataOperator`'s `batchRecords`. It never gives the reason the item requires, that each mixin is constrained to extend `ServerDataOperatorBase`. It also says two handlers bypass `batchRecords`, which contradicts the item's claim that every handler's writes go through it.
